heroSlides.title: Expert Roofing Services in Thornbury
heroSlides.sub: From installations to inspections, we've got you covered

aboutText: CAS Roofing Group has been serving Thornbury and the greater Melbourne area for over 30 years. We specialise in new roofs, re-roofs, and comprehensive roofing services using high-quality Colorbond Steel. Our licensed and certified team delivers professional workmanship for both residential and commercial projects. With a focus on quality and reliability, we handle everything from installations to maintenance.
servicesText: At CAS Roofing Group, we provide a full spectrum of roofing services tailored to your needs. From new installations to repairs and inspections, our expert team ensures durable and efficient results. We use only Australian-made products to guarantee quality and performance for your home or business.

services.title: New Roofs & Re-Roofs
services.desc: Installation on new homes, complete restorations, and replacement with Colorbond Steel for lasting protection and a modern look.

services.title: Metal Fascias & Gutters
services.desc: We offer a wide range of gutter profiles, fascia covers, and downpipes to complete your project with a perfect finish.

services.title: Asbestos Removal
services.desc: Professional removal and disposal of hazardous asbestos materials by certified experts, ensuring safety and compliance.

services.title: Rainwater Tanks
services.desc: Expert installation of Australian-made rainwater harvesting systems that are high-quality, durable, and affordable for your home.

services.title: Plumbing & Drainage
services.desc: Covering all types of plumbing and drainage, we provide installation and maintenance for residential projects.

services.title: Roofing Inspections & Reports
services.desc: Thorough inspections and advice, plus detailed reports for insurance claims, with the best affordable solutions.
